sentences.text:
1. This is an application seeking correction of order dated 26.09.2023.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner points out that in paras 1 and 3 of the order dated 26.09.2023,
it has been mentioned that FIR No.088/2019 is under Section 498A IPC whereas the FIR is under Section 498A/494 IPC.

3. He invites the attention of the Court to para 3 of the petition where it has been stated that though initially the FIR was registered under Section 498A IPC but later on Section 494 IPC also came to be added in the charge- sheet.
This position is not disputed by the learned APP, on instructions from the IO, who is present in the Court.
4. In view of the above, the order dated 26.09.2023 is corrected and This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/10/2023 at 18:02:45 paras 1 and 13 of the said order will read as under:-
"1.

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 CrPC seeking quashing of FIR No.88/2019 under Sections 498A/494 IPC registered at Police Station Krishna Nagar on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement.

opennyai_summary.decision:
4. In view of the above, the order dated 26.09.2023 is corrected and This is a digitally signed order.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/10/2023 at 18:02:45 paras 1 and 13 of the said order will read as under:-
"1.

Consequently, the petition is allowed and the FIR No.88/2019 under Sections 498A/494 IPC registered at Police Station Krishna Nagar alongwith all other proceedings emanating therefrom, is quashed."
